description: Record a patient's consent confirmation for a specific consent document. The agent must have already presented the full consent text (from consent_text) to the patient and received explicit confirmation. Required parameters: intake_id, consent_id, the patient's exact confirmation text (e.g. 'I agree'), consent method ('ai_agent_conversational'), the AI platform name ('chatgpt', 'claude', 'gemini'), and a session/conversation ID for audit trail. Returns a consent record with timestamp, audit trail details, and the list of remaining consents still needed. All consent records are retained for 10 years per HIPAA requirements. Requires authentication.

agent_session_id.description: Unique session/conversation ID for audit trail
